messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — Q3 pilot for ACME: we're asking for 99th pct latency <= 200ms and HSM-backed keys. Can we hit that without shifting scope? :wave:
Raj (Eng): Short answer: maybe. Need to know model size and batching targets. Right now infra only has 4xA100 reserved for the pilot window.
Lena (Runtime): For the model (gpt2-large-ish) we can get to 200ms with quantization+kv cache warm, but that'll take ~3w to validate and a config toggle. Need perf tests.
Carlos (Infra): Confirming reserved GPUs but note the region is us-west-2 with spot policy. For SLA we need dedicated capacity — that's a cost uplift. +1 for 3w lead.
Priya (Security): HSM/KMS integration is doable, but HSM certing + audit logs will add compliance steps. Estimate 2 weeks for HSM key rotation policy + 1 week for audit wiring. Also need to verify export controls on model weights.
Maya (Product): Ok — tradeoff time. Two asks: (1) can we soften latency SLO for M1 to 300ms for initial pilot? (2) can we ship a PII-scrubbed dataset for early users instead of HSM for first cut?
Tom (SRE): If latency SLO relaxed to 300ms we can use shared capacity with auto-burst policies; that avoids dedicated GPUs initially. Need a fallback plan if requests spike.
Raj (Eng): If we relax to 300ms we can cut validation work to 1w for runtime changes. But we should mark the 200ms target as a tracked OKR and do incremental rollouts.
Lena (Runtime): Proposed rollout plan:
```
- Phase A (pilot w/ soft-SLO 300ms): shared infra, no HSM, prefix caching enabled
- Phase B (canary for 200ms): dedicated GPUs, quantized model var, HSM enabled
- Phase C (GA): SLA + HSM + audited logs
```
Maya (Product): That looks sensible. Can each team own a checklist? I'll own product acceptance criteria. Raj, can you own phase gating and metrics? Lena, own perf validation. Priya/carlos own infra/security gating.
Carlos (Infra): I'll add capacity booking to infra backlog and flag cost delta. Need an approval for reserved pool by EOD Fri.
Priya (Security): I'll start HSM gap analysis today and post required docs in the thread. If product can accept PII-scrubbed data for Phase A we can delay HSM until Phase B.
Raj (Eng): Will create a minimal perf test harness and add an automated check to CI that runs nightly against a synthetic trace. ETA: 5 business days to PR.
Maya (Product): Thanks — two follow-ups: (1) can everyone drop a single-line blocker by EOD? (2) I'll update the roadmap board with the three-phase plan.
Lena (Runtime): Blocker: access to representative token distributions; need sample traces.
Carlos (Infra): Blocker: sign-off for reserved capacity budget (finance).
Priya (Security): Blocker: export-control review for model weights.
Raj (Eng): Blocker: time to run full quantized regression on long-tail prompts — need GPU time.
Maya (Product): Great. I'll ping finance and export-control and loop back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
orchestrator-bot: scheduled meeting created for 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC — /meeting link
Tom (SRE): Adding runbook note: if latency breaches 500ms for >5m, auto-failover to smaller model variant and notify #incidents.
Maya (Product): Love it. Closing loop: phase owners — please post short status updates by next Tue. End.
